data_note: Public dashboard tracking begins on Opening Night, March 25, 2026. Trained on 2024 and 2025 season data.

tier_guide.label: elite
tier_guide.description: Most selective subset on the board. Current production policy starts at the top 99% of each slate.

tier_guide.label: strong
tier_guide.description: Main public board after the elite subset is carved out.

tier_guide.label: watch
tier_guide.description: Worth monitoring, but lower-confidence than the main public board.

tier_guide.label: longshot
tier_guide.description: Visible only when all tiers are enabled.

runs.label: Prepare
runs.description: Runs once after 6:00 AM ET, refreshes data, retrains the model for the day, settles any remaining prior results, and saves the fixed morning baseline slate.

runs.time_et: Every 5 minutes until last first pitch
runs.label: Mixed refresh
runs.description: Keeps the morning board fixed while updating statuses and annotating only major alerts such as scratches or severe weather.

runs.label: Settle
runs.description: Checks today's board from first pitch through final, updates each entry in place, and archives the whole slate only after every tracked game is complete.

model_explainer.title: How rankings work
model_explainer.summary: 10 metrics are active in the current model. The percentages below are normalized model importance weights, not literal linear coefficients.

features.label: Peak Exit Velocity, Last 10 Days
features.description: Recent top-end exit velocity. This is used as a ceiling signal for raw home-run juice.
features.direction: Higher values generally boost the score

features.label: HR Rate, Last 30 Days
features.description: Home-run rate over the last 30 days. It captures whether the hitter has been sustaining power recently.
features.direction: Higher values generally boost the score

features.label: Hard-Hit Rate, Last 30 Days
features.description: 30-day hard-hit trend, used as a broader measure of how consistently loud the hitter's contact has been.
features.direction: Higher values generally boost the score

features.label: Average Exit Velocity, Last 10 Days
features.description: Average recent exit velocity. It measures how hard the hitter is striking the ball lately.
features.direction: Higher values generally boost the score

features.label: Barrel Rate, Last 30 Days
features.description: Longer recent barrel trend, used as a sustained power-quality signal.
features.direction: Higher values generally boost the score

features.label: Hard-Hit Rate, Last 10 Days
features.description: Share of recent batted balls hit hard. This helps the model separate live contact quality from raw outcomes.
features.direction: Higher values generally boost the score

features.label: HR Rate, Last 10 Days
features.description: Recent home-run rate over the last 10 days. This is the shortest-term power trend input.
features.direction: Higher values generally lower the score

features.label: Barrel Rate, Last 10 Days
features.description: Recent barrel frequency, measuring how often the hitter is producing ideal home-run quality contact right now.
features.direction: Higher values generally boost the score

features.label: 95+ EV Rate, Last 10 Days
features.description: How often recent contact has cleared 95 mph. It is a compact proxy for current dangerous contact.
features.direction: Neutral effect in the fitted model

features.label: 95+ EV Rate, Last 30 Days
features.description: 30-day loud-contact rate, used to stabilize recent quality-of-contact signals.
features.direction: Neutral effect in the fitted model

ballparkpal_explainer.title: Ballpark Pal weights
ballparkpal_explainer.summary: Ballpark Pal XX.X is the slate-normalized Batter HomeRunProbability score on a 0-100 scale. 50.0 is neutral; above 50.0 is favorable and below 50.0 is unfavorable. The Today slider defaults to a 10/90 Ballpark Pal/model blend and can re-rank the live board.
ballparkpal_explainer.score_note: Ballpark Pal XX.X is the slate-normalized Batter.HomeRunProbability score in the HR Chance cell.
ballparkpal_explainer.blend_note: Use the Today slider to reweight the live board from 0% to 100% Ballpark Pal against the model.
ballparkpal_explainer.ranking_note: Confidence tiers are derived from the blended score percentile on the slate.

factors.label: Batters.HomeRunProbability
factors.description: Direct Batter.HomeRunProbability value from the Batters export, shown as a 0-100 score.
